ABOUT.TITLE: About SwishAI
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: SwishAI is an AI-powered basketball video analysis tool that uses advanced computer vision to detect and track shots, balls, and players in basketball footage. Analyze your game, improve your skills, and gain insights with cutting-edge AI technology.

GUIDE.TITLE: For Best Results
GUIDE.LIGHTING_DESC: Ensure the court is well lit and avoid strong backlights.
GUIDE.VIEW_DESC: The camera must clearly see the hoop and the shooter.
GUIDE.DURATION_DESC: 1 min on mobile or when not logged in, 5 min when logged in, and unlimited with a subscription. Videos are trimmed to the limit.
GUIDE.EXAMPLE_PROMPT: Curious what the result looks like?
GUIDE.WEBGPU_WARNING: WebGPU is not available here, so processing will be much slower. Switch to a computer with a recent browser: {{browsers}}.
GUIDE.WEBGPU_HW_ACCEL_HINT: If you're already on one, make sure hardware acceleration is turned on in the browser settings.
GUIDE.WEBGPU_WARNING_LINUX: WebGPU is off here, so processing will be much slower. On Linux it usually needs to be turned on by hand.
GUIDE.WEBGPU_LINUX_CHROME: Chrome or Chromium: open chrome://flags, enable "Unsafe WebGPU Support" and "Vulkan", then restart the browser. "Unsafe" only means experimental.
GUIDE.WEBGPU_LINUX_FIREFOX: Firefox: open about:config, set dom.webgpu.enabled to true and restart. If it still doesn't work, also set gfx.webgpu.ignore-blocklist to true.
GUIDE.NATIVE_FALLBACK_WARNING: The GPU-accelerated pipeline could not start, so this video is being processed by the slower in-app one.

UPLOAD.FORMATS: Supports MP4 and MOV. Some AVI files work too.
UPLOAD.VIDEO_EXCEEDS_LIMIT: Your video is {{duration}}. Only the first {{limit}} will be processed.
UPLOAD.UPGRADE_HINT_LOGIN: Log in to process up to {{limit}}.
UPLOAD.LOW_SPEC_WARNING: Your PC has specifications lower than recommended. Processing will take longer than usual. We recommend using better hardware for faster processing speeds.
UPLOAD.MOBILE_PERF_WARNING: You're on a mobile device: processing is slower here and videos are limited to {{limit}} min. For the best experience, use a computer.
UPLOAD.SHOW_OVERLAY_DESC: Draws detection boxes, labels and the shot zone on the annotated video. Off means only the score panel and the ball trajectory.
UPLOAD.HIDE_WATERMARK_DESC: Removes the SwishAI logo from the output video.
UPLOAD.LARGE_FILE: This file is {{size}}, which is a lot to hold in memory at once.
UPLOAD.LARGE_FILE_HINT: The run may fail part way on this device. A shorter clip is the safer bet.

PROGRESS.ERROR_DESC: An unknown error occurred. Please try a different video.
PROGRESS.SOFTWARE_DECODE_NOTICE: Your browser can't decode HEVC directly, so we're doing it in software — this will take longer. To speed it up: iPhone › Settings › Camera › Formats › Most Compatible, or convert the file to H.264.
PROGRESS.ERROR_HEVC: This HEVC video couldn't be decoded. Try converting it to H.264 MP4.
PROGRESS.ERROR_CODEC: This video uses a format the browser cannot read here ({{codecs}}). Convert it to H.264 MP4 and try again.
PROGRESS.ERROR_UNREADABLE_FILE: This file could not be read as an MP4 video. Try an MP4 recorded with H.264.
PROGRESS.STATS_TRUNCATED: These numbers cover only the first part of your video: {{limit}} of {{duration}}.
PROGRESS.STATS_TRUNCATED_NO_DURATION: These numbers cover only the first {{limit}} of your video.
PROGRESS.PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE: The annotated video is no longer saved on this device. These numbers are still from your last run.
PROGRESS.RUN_INTERRUPTED: We didn't get to finish {{name}}. Pick the file again to start over.
PROGRESS.CPU_FALLBACK_NOTICE: WebGPU could not be used for this run, so it's running on the CPU and will take longer.
